claim: In an alarm's warm-up configuration, the required WarmUpPeriodDurationInMinutes setting takes a value from 1 to 2,880 minutes (2 days); warm-up periods work with metric alarms and log alarms.

evidence.quote: `WarmUpPeriodDurationInMinutes` (required) – The warm-up duration, in minutes. Specify a value from 1 to 2,880 minutes (2 days).
Warm-up periods work with metric alarms and log alarms.
